notice: Review output only. Authorises no implementation, connection, posting, payment, sending, deployment or policy activation, and opens no gate. verdict: All 17 findings are answered. 16 are corrected as specified. PR-11 is documented but still needs the owner's explicit confirmation. Ten smaller gaps remain (PRV-01 to PRV-10): one must be done with the next code change because the register must reflect this review (PRV-01, P2); the rest are P3. Six product decisions remain with the owner.

current_gaps.title: The evidence rule of the register check accepts evidence that names nothing real
current_gaps.evidence: scripts/check_product_requirements.py line 58: the pattern accepts any text containing tests/test_<word>.py, any token starting with R and a digit or with RB, or any PR-<number>. Fault cases F21 (a test file that does not exist), F22 ('See PR-04') and F23 ('R2D2 says so') are accepted (evidence/register_fault_tests_output.txt). AAOS-GOV-02 itself is Developer-tested partly on 'PR-04/PR-17'.
current_gaps.proposed_correction: Require at least one tests/test_*.py path that exists under the project root, or a probe id that appears in one of the probe scripts under exports/ or review/. Do not count ticket ids as evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Fault cases F21, F22 and F23 are rejected.
